avis.titre: There’s Better Clinique Products Out There
avis.texte: The product is about an inch in size and looks more like a sample size than an actual product! 22 dollars for such a small sample seems like robbery when you could go to a mall and ask for a tester’s sample first. If you use this product, make sure to have something moisturizing afterwards as well, because the salicylic acid dries your skin severely and makes it flake off. For me, I have oily/dry combination and acne prone skin. I follow a routine of using the same 4 products: Clinique’s acne solution (facial cleanser, toner, anti-blemish solutions, and serum), but Clinique ran out of the anti-blemish solution for about 2-3 months now. The lotion worked amazing, since it had both salicylic acid and glycerin, which helped trap moisture into your skin. This product, on the other hand, caused dead skin to pile up and result in more breakouts than fixing damages. It feels like another product to sell to consumers to force them to buy more lotions, personally. As soon as the anti-blemish lotion comes back, I’m not using this item anymore.

avis.titre: Gel for clearing acne for all sexes & all ages
avis.texte: I’ve used this since I was a teen & am now 65+, it is the best treatment for blemishes (yes, older people do get zits too!). It does dry the skin out a bit, but can be used under a moisturizer and makeup. No scent. Hypoallergenic, no animal testing. It is effective in drying up zits, easy to apply . It does cost a bit much, but it’s the best I have ever found. My son who is 32 has his own tube & has been using since he was a teen. It does not irritate the skin after shaving.
Very effective. This works overnight. Dries out the pimple. Apply moisturizer afterwards since it dries out.

avis.titre: Zit Happens: Let This Gel Be Your Pimple’s Worst Enemy
avis.texte: The Clinique Acne Solutions Clinical Clearing Gel is like the overzealous law-and-order officer in your skincare routine — it means business when it comes to blemishes. Packed with acne-fighting salicylic acid and soothing witch hazel, this clear gel zips into pores to help dissolve oil and dead skin that lead to breakouts while keeping things lightweight and non-greasy. I find it helps calm and shrink pimples over time without turning your face into the Sahara, though a bit of dryness or tightness can occur (so moisturize like it’s your job). It isn’t some magical overnight miracle, but with regular use it works hard at clearing and preventing spots without feeling like a sticky science experiment.
Is really good for acne and clears it up fast for those small breakout we women get. They need to make a body wash out of this stuff. I purchase this frequently when I get low. ( Mrs. Sotrh)

avis.titre: Barbie sized tube for $$$ not worth it!!
avis.texte: I was pretty shocked when this arrived because it’s the size of a sample or an item you might receive as a free gift with purchase. $23 for a sample size is ridiculous. The product itself is really good but I use it sparingly to make the tiny tube last. Even though I love it, I am more likely to spend my money on a dupe elsewhere.
Horrible- It kind of burnt my skin. I always buy this from Sephora, 1st time bought it from AMAZON. Terrible.
